summary: All 10 acceptance criteria met. Six SYMBOL_SPECIALIZATION_* config keys present with friend's defaults (True/3/5/10/10/6). `_build_symbol_specialized_variants` correctly generates 1-, 2-, and 3-symbol variants, filters via `gate_positive_good` with configured min-trade thresholds (10 train / 6 val), scores by `min(train_return, val_return)`, and returns top-K sorted. When `USE_COMBINATIONS=False`, only single-symbol variants returned. When `True`, 2- and 3-symbol `itertools.combinations` of top-5 symbols are generated and scored. Early-exit preserves rules with existing symbol conditions and handles empty symbols. Wire-in at `Rule_Set_Selector.run()` correctly delegates to `_build_multi_symbol_merged_rules` (new path) when `True`, falls back to preserved `_merge_per_symbol_rules` when `False`. 24 unit tests pass covering helpers, variant generation, gating, scoring, merge integration, config keys, importability, and backward compatibility. Existing `test_phase3_rule_set.py` passes without regression. No changes to evaluator_v5.ipynb, GPU engine, or JSON output contract. Two minor observations (non-blocking): (1) `itertools.combinations` is imported inside the function body rather than at module top; (2) `max_symbols=1` override when `use_combinations=False` is dead code since the combo loop is already guarded.
